note: Making at camp (docs/future/13 sections 3.12 and 6; S1, October 24, 2026; S2 and P2j, October 25). Read by src/world/camp/making.js (pure) and src/world/camp/stations.js (live). A make's parts are what is laid on a station's surface, one handful each; nothing is taken until its action is pressed, and then each handful comes from the pack first, then the camp's piles, then the hamper (P2j). Tier is for the docs and labs only: the code checks parts and what is already made, never a tier.
buildsNote: Things built in their own camp slot, the way the ring is laid (CS-05): the slot glows while the pack (or a pile at camp, or the hamper) holds the parts and you are near camp, once the ring is laid (afterRing); its card offers Build; the walker plays act at the slot and the parts leave. parts: [kind, handfuls] pairs. The first build is written on the camp page. The apothecary bench (S2) is lashed from sticks with rush cord, so it waits for cord.
makesNote: Every make at a station. at: the station (workbench, fire, apothecary); act: its action's icon and label (words.acts), else the station's own; parts: one handful each, a kind id, a list of kinds that serve (['sticks', 'drift-twigs']), or any kind of a pack group ({ group: 'herbs', shows: the kind its pencil outline wears }); after: a camp slot that must be built first (the mortar and rack wait for the apothecary bench, the second hamper for the first, Dry for the rack, Grind for the mortar); out: where it goes when made ('tool' hangs on the pack and takes no pouch, kept in the cook section's tools; 'pouch' fills a pouch of gives, count handfuls, or a small heap at your feet when the pack is full; 'slot' stands in its camp slot (slot), carried there; 'stack' stacks a second hamper on the first, 6 slots to 12; 'rack' hangs the herb on the drying rack as a bunch); max: how many can ever be made (the station stops offering it). Rush cord (P2c): one handful of rushes or marram leaves twisted into one handful of cord. The shovel needs a stick, a flat stone and cord. The drying rack: two withies or sticks lashed with cord; the mortar: a flat stone hollowed with a pebble. The hamper (P2j): two handfuls of rushes coiled and stitched with cord; the second hamper takes rushes, cord and a willow-withy lid. Dry hangs a handful of any herb on the rack; Grind turns a handful of broken shells into crushed shell (Mix waits for P2e). One make is shown at a time: the one with the most parts laid, then the lower tier, then this file's order.
makeSNote: How long the walker works at the station for a make (real seconds), kneeling at the bench: figure.json gestures.make. The thing is made as it ends.
nothingHoldSNote: Parts that make nothing together stay on the surface this long (real seconds) with the calm line, then go back to their pouches.
